name: Community Of The Cross
addr: 3227 N Fork Left Fork, Black Mountain, NC 28711

reviews.t: I've visited the Community of the Cross for more than 20 years, and it has always been such an amazing place. The woodland trails are beautiful. The new Prayer House is an inspiring place for worship, teaching, and prayer. The hospitality has always been so warm and welcoming. Most of all, this has been a place of profound encounters with Jesus through the power of his Holy Spirit. My faith and discipleship have been challenged, strengthened, and enriched because of the way God's presence has been manifest. In the language of Celtic Christianity, this is one of those "thin places" - sites where God's presence was more easily encountered, almost as if there was no barrier between the spiritual and physical realms.

Hurricane Helene caused major devastation to this area, completely rerouted the river and swept away everything in its path. Kudos to the hardworking teams whose efforts cleared the debris, stabilized the banks, rebuilt the road and replaced the infrastructure. The Community of the Cross was unable to function during this time, but the property was used as a staging area for the repair crews. When I asked one of the crew chiefs if they would try to restore the river back to its original path, the response was no, the new river path would remain where Hurricane Helene put it. It looks very different. The water no longer flows under the bridge, and the repair crews had to install the large culverts under the new road. The old spillway under the bridge is now completely dry. The Community of the Cross has also graciously hosted teams of volunteers who have come in to help rebuild housing in nearby Swannanoa for those who lost their homes in the flooding. Community of the Cross has also been actively involved in the preservation of the many old hemlock trees on its property. It is very committed to being good stewards of the land. People accusing it of anything other than that are ill-informed and ignorant of the facts. It is a still a beautiful retreat spot and I am glad the Community of the Cross is fully operational again and that the youth and others from around the community are starting to come back to what was, and is becoming again, a popular swimming spot, especially during these hot sultry summer days. Let the kids play.

Beautiful location, devastated by Hurricane Helene. Beavers used to dam the river, and the banks were green and tree-lined. The river changed course, dropped over 10 feet, & swept away road and trees. Thankful for repairs to bridge & road by the City, & debris clean-up by voluntary aid workers. City have protected the boundaries with boulders. Critics should check their facts, LOL ;-) Fact - the tidying up of all the landscape and river banks was done by the City and aid agencies. Trolls should talk to them if they don't like where they put the boulders. Fact - even with the little stone dam that the kids were building, the *same quantity of water* would still be flowing downstream. Just basic physics from school, ROFL. (Or do they think it magically disappears so there are dry spots downstream?!) Fact - the riverbed dropped due to the hurricane torrent, and the water bypassed the bridge and washed away the road. The big so-called 'dam' (if that's what the trolls are referring to) is not man-made. Maybe the trolls have a conspiracy theory about the government causing this by cloud seeding ...but whatever, it wasn't the Community of the Cross that rerouted the river and caused that big blockage.

the dam you’ve been building is drying out the river, causing the eco system surrounding to collapse. this is incredibly dissapointing, and shows that there is truly no love for your neighbors. this river has been a staple in many lives, not just the people living here but animals, plants, you are removing the beautiful biodiversity of this land it is incredible upsetting and angering. what will you do when what was once a beautiful river becomes a dry ghost of what it once was? will you put a walmart there? the issue with the boulders blocking the entrance to the land alsp causes issues as it prevents the people who really love this land from being able to access and take care of it. please remove the boulders. please make representations and love the land as your god asks you too, destruction of his land is unholy.

The new prayer house is the most incredible place to worship. I also enjoyed taking several different walks the grounds have to offer.
